title: Add per-prompt regression CI hook and metrics integration for eval-harness
author: Riley Chen
release_notes: Add per-prompt regression CI hook and per-prompt metrics export. No breaking changes.
description: Motivation: We need tighter per-prompt regression detection in CI and better per-prompt metrics visibility for the eval-harness to quickly catch quality regressions introduced by model or prompt changes. This PR adds a CI hook that runs the per-prompt evaluation subset during PRs, computes per-prompt metrics (accuracy/rouge/semantic-similarity depending on prompt type), and publishes summary metrics tagged by prompt-set and prompt-id to Prometheus/Grafana. It also includes a lightweight quality gating rule that can fail CI on regressions beyond configurable thresholds, and a metrics integration to send detailed per-prompt results to our existing metrics pipeline. Changes: - New CI hook runner ci/hooks/per_prompt_regression.py that executes a targeted prompt subset and computes metrics. - Integration layer eval_harness/metrics/prometheus_exporter.py to push per-prompt gauges and histogram buckets. - Pipeline changes ci/templates/pipeline.yaml to wire the hook into PR checks and to conditionally fail based on thresholds. - Tests at tests/ci/test_per_prompt_hook.py and small internal fixtures under tests/fixtures/per_prompt_samples.json. - Documentation updates docs/ci.md with how to configure thresholds and interpret per-prompt graphs. Checklist: - [x] Hook runner implemented - [x] Metrics exporter implemented - [x] CI pipeline wired - [x] Unit+integration tests - [x] Docs updated - [x] Reviewed and approved by reviewers Testing/verification: Ran unit tests and integration suite locally and in CI. First CI run hit a timeout on the heavy prompt suite; we added an adaptive sample-size cap and re-ran. Final CI passed. Rollout plan: Feature gated behind env var EVAL_HOOK_PER_PROMPT=false by default; enable on canary repos for 2 weeks, observe per-prompt alerts in Grafana. Related: ENG-1452 (per-prompt alerting), ENG-1487 (eval metrics pipeline), SUP-4321 (customer ticket that motivated tighter gating).
